dialogues.jp:
今日は歴史の授業と言うより、ずっと豆知識的
な話が続いている。
dialogues.en:
Today's history lesson was even more boring than usual; the
lesson just sounded like an endless robotic drone to me.
dialogues.text:
Today's history lesson was even more boring than usual; the
lesson just sounded like an endless robotic drone to me.

dialogues.jp:
中根先生の話は面白くていいんだけど……どう
もおばあちゃんの知恵袋に話がかたよってるん
だよな。
dialogues.en:
It's not that Nakane-sensei's classes are boring... but
she's pretty old, and shows it when she constantly goes off
the topic...
dialogues.text:
It's not that Nakane-sensei's classes are boring... but
she's pretty old, and shows it when she constantly goes off
the topic...

dialogues.speaker: Nakane-sensei
dialogues.jp:
「いざってときのタメに、食べられる草を覚え
　ておくといいぞ」
dialogues.en:
"In times of desperate need, don't forget that grass is
edible."
dialogues.text:
"In times of desperate need, don't forget that grass is
edible."

dialogues.speaker: Nakane-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「この辺りで生えている雑草でいうと……」
dialogues.en: "SUch as the weeds shown here, called..."
dialogues.text: "SUch as the weeds shown here, called..."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、草の名前と、特徴、生えている場
所などを説明していく。
dialogues.en:
With that, she explained the name of the weed, and the
locations it's normally found in.
dialogues.text:
With that, she explained the name of the weed, and the
locations it's normally found in.

dialogues.jp: しかも、なぜか調理法と味の感想つき……。
dialogues.en:
But why on earth are we learning cooking and survival
techniques now...
dialogues.text:
But why on earth are we learning cooking and survival
techniques now...

dialogues.jp:
中根先生の歴史の授業は、ほとんどおばあちゃ
んの知恵袋と大差ない内容だ。食べられる草の
話なんかを聞いた。調理法まで……。
